overview.subtitle: All of NIR · last {{days}} days ({{from}} – {{to}})
overview.overTimeNote: Created vs. expired without update · daily
overview.overTimeLabel: Requests created and expired per day
overview.overTimeSummary: {{created}} created and {{expired}} expired without update in this period.
overview.noRequests: No requests were created in this period.

users.title: User management
users.subtitle: Manage roles and account status. Passwords and tokens are never visible to anyone.
users.caption: Accounts

drawer.title: Account details
drawer.hiddenBody: Password, API tokens, saved requests and personal preferences. Use “Send password reset” instead of setting passwords.
drawer.resetSentBody: {{email}} can set a new password from the link.
drawer.note: Every change here is written to the audit log with your name and a reason.
drawer.self: This is your own account. Another administrator has to change your role or restrict it.
drawer.pending: Role change to {{role}} is waiting for a second administrator.
drawer.failedBody: It may have changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.

role.title: Change role

descriptions.facility_submitter: Create requests for one authorized desk; can’t publish.
descriptions.coordinator: Review and publish requests in an assigned area.
descriptions.admin: Requires a second administrator to approve.

role.areaHelp: Coordinators only see review queues for their area.
role.deskHelp: Submitters can only create requests for this desk.
role.pendingBody: Another administrator must approve making {{name}} an administrator.

restrict.title: Restrict {{name}}?
restrict.body: They’ll be signed out everywhere and can’t sign in, save requests or submit anything. Their past audit entries stay intact. You can lift the restriction later.
restrict.reasonHelp: Kept in the audit log. When signing in, the user sees a neutral message, not the reason.
restrict.doneBody: {{name}} has been signed out and can’t sign in.
restrict.liftBody: They can sign in again. Requests paused by the restriction resume; anything that expired meanwhile stays expired.

coordinators.title: Coordinator management
coordinators.subtitle: Who can review and publish, and where.
coordinators.uncovered_one: No coordinator covers {{areas}}. Requests there wait in the NIR-wide queue for an administrator.
coordinators.uncovered_other: No coordinator covers {{areas}}. Requests there wait in the NIR-wide queue for an administrator.
coordinators.caption: Coordinators
coordinators.empty: No coordinators yet. Give someone the Coordinator role from User Management.

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.subtitle: Append-only record of security-relevant actions. Read-only for all administrators.
audit.note: Entries can’t be edited or deleted here. Retention: kept for 1 year, then names are removed by a separately authorized job.
audit.caption: Audit log

settings.title: System settings
settings.subtitle: What the platform runs with today. Values live in code and the server environment and change through a deployment — secrets are never shown here.

expiry.title: Request expiration
expiry.body: Requests leave the map automatically when they expire.
expiry.defaultValue: When the desk window closes on the needed-by date ({{end}} if none is given)
expiry.maxExtensionValue: Up to {{hours}} hours, once per approval
expiry.reminderHelp: Sent to owners and people who saved it.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Email and in-app. Sending is queued.
notifications.owner: Owners are emailed when a request is approved, sent back or rejected
notifications.savers: People who saved a request get updates by their own preference
notifications.digest: Weekly digest to donors — not sent yet (not designed)

health.title: System health
health.driverLog: Driver: {{driver}} — written to the log, not delivered

secrets.title: Secrets & credentials
secrets.body: API keys, mail credentials and the AI provider key are stored as server environment variables and are never displayed or editable here. Rotate them through your deployment pipeline.
